data.exact_reserve_text: A favourable run-off deviation (prior accident year increase) of GBP 2.5m (2015: run-off deviation of GBP 2.9m) was experienced during the year, wholly in respect of reserve movements on the 2014 year of account and prior Whole Account Quota Share contract with Syndicate 2003.

prior_year_events.event_name: 2014 year of account reserve movements (and prior Whole Account Quota Share contract with Syndicate 2003)
prior_year_events.impact_description: Favourable run-off deviation of GBP 2.5m experienced during the year, wholly in respect of reserve movements on the 2014 year of account and prior Whole Account Quota Share contract with Syndicate 2003.

data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate reported a small favourable prior-year reserve development: a GBP 2.5m release relating wholly to reserve movements on the 2014 year of account and prior Whole Account Quota Share contract with Syndicate 2003. This equates to approximately a 1.7% release relative to opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2016. The movement is described as a favourable run-off deviation and is attributed to favourable claims development on those prior years.
raw_causal_phrases: A favourable run-off deviation (prior accident year increase) of GBP 2.5m (2015: run-off deviation of GBP 2.9m) was experienced during the year, wholly in respect of reserve movements on the 2014 year of account and prior Whole Account Quota Share contract with Syndicate 2003.

The underwriting performance in 2016 was driven by challenging market conditions affecting nearly all lines of business with ongoing "soft" market conditions, low rating environment and capacity in the market. In 2016 a large number of catastrophe losses occurred as compared to 2015 where the syndicate benefited from very low levels of attritional losses and claims for natural catastrophes.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from the Statement of Financial Position (Claims outstanding comparative / prior year). Prior-year movement sourced from the 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note which explicitly states a favourable run-off deviation of GBP 2.5m relating to the 2014 year and prior WAQS; treated as a release (-2.5). No LOB-specific quantum for the prior-year movement is provided. No specific named catastrophe events quantified in the report; the claims development triangle and segmental tables were available and used. Page numbering reflects the printed document pages where items appear.
